title: Leases
intro: المستأجر يسجل **أصل حق استخدام** و**التزام عقد إيجار** لكل العقود تقريباً.
الالتزام = القيمة الحالية لدفعات الإيجار، مخصومة بالمعدل الضمني أو **معدل الاقتراض الإضافي**.
إعفاءات اختيارية: العقود **قصيرة الأجل (12 شهر أو أقل)** والأصول **منخفضة القيمة**.

tf.s: Lessees classify leases as finance or operating under IFRS 16.
tf.why: Only lessors classify. Lessees use one model.

tf.s: The lease term includes extension periods if the lessee is reasonably certain to exercise the option.
tf.why: That is part of the lease term.

tf.s: If ownership does not transfer, the ROU asset is depreciated over the shorter of the lease term and its useful life.
Lessors recognise operating lease income usually on a straight-line basis.
Interest on the lease liability is included in depreciation.
tf.why: Interest is a finance cost; depreciation is on the ROU asset.

tf.s: A lessee may choose not to recognise ROU assets for leases of 12 months or less.
